sources.label: Jaipur Metro unofficial constructed static GTFS
sources.notes: Backs metro_gtfs_stops.geojson (11) and metro_gtfs_routes.geojson (1). Constructed from public Jaipur Metro route/station material plus saved OSM station geometry; not an agency-published GTFS feed.

sources.label: OpenStreetMap via Overpass/OSM API - Jaipur Metro fallback geometry
sources.notes: Backs metro.geojson (11 stations) and metro_lines.geojson (44 line features). OSM fallback geometry; official Jaipur Metro static GTFS remains a separate missing-source row.

sources.label: Jaipur JCTSL OSM route-relation fallback GTFS
sources.notes: Backs bus_stops.geojson (72 endpoint stops) and bus_routes.geojson (36 route-direction geometries). Constructed from OSM route relations tagged operator=JCTSL; endpoint stops come from relation from/to tags and route way endpoints, not agency stop-level schedules.

sources.label: JCTSL official route-list PDF, archived 2026-07-04
sources.notes: Archived source context for Jaipur city-bus routes. It is not a static GTFS feed and does not by itself provide stop-level geometry.

sources.label: Jaipur transit source status manifest
sources.notes: Records the official Jaipur Metro and JCTSL static-GTFS gaps separately from the constructed/fallback public layers.
